posts.title: NASA Science
posts.lead: Sometimes it's night on the ground but day in the air. As the Earth rotates to eclipse the Sun, sunset rises upfrom the ground. Therefore, at sunset on the ground, sunlight still shines on clouds above.

posts.title: NASA’s Perseverance Views Dust at Neretva Vallis
posts.lead: Description This 360-degree look at Neretva Vallis within Mars’ Jezero Crater was stitched together using 217 images acquired by the rover’s Mastcam-Z on May 20, 2024, the 1,155th Martian day, or sol, of the mission.

posts.title: NEO Surveyor’s Sunshade Gets Inspected
